annotations.text:
The editor is the product. Try it:
- click a node in the tree to allocate or unallocate it
- unallocate the Attribute node feeding Kindling and the disconnected error appears
- remove the Abiding Hex chip and its warning goes
- Apply on the suggestion sockets Concentrated Effect
Every finding states where it came from: derived from catalog data, parsed from support_text with partial coverage, or curated. That line is the reason a player can trust or discount it.

Gem paths, unique names and the .build ids are real 0.5.5 data from the step 0 spike.

The tree itself is synthetic: real PoE2 orbit geometry (radii 82/164/334/488..., 12/24/72 slots per orbit), invented positions and names. Shipping real node coordinates would be the redistribution measure 5 forbids.
